PK.description: Partition Key - ALWAYS 'CUSTOMER#<customer_id>'. Enables querying all data for one customer.

SK.description: Sort Key - ALWAYS 'REVIEW#<timestamp>'. Enables sorting reviews chronologically.

ReviewID.description: Unique identifier for the specific review (Generated by the pipeline).

ReviewTimestamp.description: The date and time the review was submitted (ISO 8601 format).

SentimentScore.description: Numerical score representing the review sentiment (e.g., -1 to 1, calculated by pipeline).

SentimentLabel.description: Categorical sentiment label (e.g., 'Positive', 'Neutral', 'Negative', calculated by pipeline).

Summary.description: A concise summary of the review content (generated by pipeline).

CustomerStatus.description: Structured details about the customer's subscription and status.

IsPayingCustomer.description: True if SubscriptionLevel is Premium or Pro.

ChatTranscript.description: The structured conversation history that constitutes the review (mapped from RawChatHistory).

RecentPageVisits.description: Structured list of the user's recent page visits, including the full HTML scrape (mapped from RawWebHistory).

URL.description: The URL of the page visited.

VisitTime.description: The time the user landed on the page.

FullPageHTML.description: The complete HTML content of the page scrape. (Be mindful of the 400KB item limit.)
